statistical_model.c_model: C_model[i,j] = (Σ_k f0_k J_{i,k})ᵀ Σ (Σ_l f0_l J_{j,l}) — propagated MF33 XS covariance, shared-parameter correlations included
statistical_model.coverage: cross_section_mf33 only — same scope as the forward bands; decay/yield channels and transport/model discrepancy are not inferred
statistical_model.estimate: two-pass: measurement-weighted NNLS point f0, then GLS NNLS under C = C_meas + C_model(f0)
statistical_model.posterior: C_post = (Aᵀ C⁻¹ A + λI)⁻¹, λ = 1e-9·mean(diag(AᵀC⁻¹A)) — a declared weak ridge keeping degenerate directions finite
